messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: Planning a quick 'Spring Kudos' kit (postcard + enamel pin) to send to contributors from Q1. Scope: ~220 folks, distributed. Need volunteers for address pull, packaging, and a brief UPS drop. Timeline: vendor proof Tue, print Wed, pack/ship Thu. Thoughts?
Diego: Happy to help with packing. Can we do an afternoon pack so East Coast folks can join?
Priya: I'll grab the addresses list from Confluence and scrub for duplicates + opt-outs. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/.../spring-kudos-addresses.csv
Sam: PeopleOps Bot can export that list: `peopleops export addresses spring-kudos`
PeopleOps Bot: Export complete: /tmp/spring_kudos_2026-04-12.csv (220 rows).
Maya (People Ops): Great. Priya please also flag contractors vs employees so we follow vendor postage rules. Diego + Sam 11 can you cover packaging and UPS manifest?
Sam: Yes. I'll prepare a labels CSV: `python infra/labels.py --in /tmp/spring_kudos_2026-04-12.csv --out labels_to_print.csv` and split intl addresses into `intl.csv`.
Priya: Note: Canada entries need CN22 customs. I'll add a column `requires_customs` in the CSV.
Diego: Afternoon packing works. How many volunteers needed?
Maya (People Ops): Estimate 4 people for a 2-hour pack to hit 220 kits. Sign up sheet: https://forms.gle/pack-spring-kudos.
Arun (Finance): Budget ok. Please submit PO and CC finance@redwood. Keep receipts for pins and printing.
Maya (People Ops): Vendor update: TinyMintables quoted pins $2.75 each (incl shipping) -> ~$605, postcards $0.60 ea -> $132, packaging supplies $40. Total ~ $777. I'll request an invoice and submit PO once proof approved.
Priya: Will clean CSV and remove 6 opt-outs, final count ~214. I'll upload final file to `/drive/people-ops/spring-kudos/final_addresses.csv`.
Sam: I'll generate shipping manifest and labels, and schedule the UPS pickup for Thu 5pm. Command I'll run: `./ops/shipbatch --carrier ups --csv final_addresses.csv --manifest out/ups_manifest.csv`
Maya (People Ops): Decision on handwritten vs printed note? Handwritten would be lovely but tight timeline. Suggest short printed message with space for a quick initials line.
Diego: Printed message + initials line sounds good. Saves time.
Maya (People Ops): OK printing selected. Action items recap: Priya finalize CSV by Mon EOD; Sam run label script and prep manifest; Diego + volunteers pack Thu afternoon; Maya submit PO and confirm pickup. PeopleOps Bot will send calendar invite.
PeopleOps Bot: Calendar invite sent for packing Thu 15:00-17:00 (Berkeley office).
Maya (People Ops): Thanks team. If vendor proof arrives early I'll push print up. Any last concerns?
Arun (Finance): Just remember international customs and VAT invoices. Otherwise approved.
Priya: Uploaded final CSV and flagged 8 international rows.
Diego: See you Thu 15:00.
Sam: I'll bring the label printer and scales.
Maya (People Ops): Perfect 11 closing thread. Thanks all!
